sources.title: Redis ZADD
sources.scope: Current command contract: double score precision and lexicographic ties; no universal throughput claim.

sources.title: OWASP password storage
sources.scope: Dedicated password KDF, salts and work factors; no MD5 or general-purpose digest as password scheme.

sources.title: JWT BCP RFC8725
sources.scope: Algorithm, issuer, audience and token-context validation; authentication is distinct from resource authorization.

sources.title: Raft paper
sources.scope: Leader replication, election safety, committed entry safety and majority availability. Paper model, not latest implementation behavior.

sources.title: NGINX upstream
sources.scope: Consistent hash and upstream configuration conditional on module/version; not a literal ring promise for every hash mode.

sources.title: Nacos2.4 configuration
sources.scope: Pinned 2.4 configuration includes Distro and Raft settings; no claim all service-instance registrations are MySQL backed.

sources.title: Consul architecture
sources.scope: Gossip membership and Raft state responsibilities separated.

sources.title: etcd API guarantees v3.6
sources.scope: Linearizable KV operations vs serializable reads and watch guarantees; watches are not a linearizable read replacement.

sources.title: Istio ambient architecture
sources.scope: Sidecar-free ztunnel L4 and optional waypoint L7 boundaries retained; Mesh not necessarily one sidecar per pod.

sources.title: Envoy outlier detection
sources.scope: Outlier ejection is signal/config-dependent; not perfect global fault detection.

sources.title: Protocol Buffers proto3
sources.scope: Varints, field identifiers and evolution constraints; no universal size/speed guarantee.

sources.title: Workers KV consistency
sources.scope: Current KV documentation: local visibility not guaranteed immediate, remote reads can lag 60 seconds or more and negative lookups cache. Serializing writes does not make KV reads strongly consistent.

sources.title: Seata2.6 overview
sources.scope: Viewed version2.6: AT local business/undo commit and global lock; ordinary SELECT does not gain automatic global read-committed.

sources.title: Mafka historical2018
sources.scope: Historical deployment batching/partition/sliding-window practice only, not current Mafka implementation or codec defaults.

sources.title: Mafka historical2019
sources.scope: Historical Kafka lineage, not identity of every current implementation.

sources.title: Workers Queues delivery
sources.scope: At-least-once and no ordering guarantee require application idempotency/version gating; not infinite lossless retention.

sources.title: Workers Queues batching retries
sources.scope: Explicit ack/retry and bounded retry/DLQ behavior; provider retry not business completion guarantee.

sources.title: Kubernetes resources
sources.scope: Requests govern scheduling and limits govern enforcement; memory pressure/OOM differs from CPU throttling. No latest-release assertion.

sources.title: Java21 CompletableFuture
sources.scope: Pinned Java21: timeout/completion/cancellation do not prove underlying remote work stopped.

sources.title: Kubernetes Pod lifecycle
sources.scope: Termination grace/draining and readiness semantics; rolling replacement alone cannot guarantee zero interruption.
